name: Full Metal Racket (VST3)
description: A free Windows VST3 analogue drum machine. Twelve voices, nothing sampled and nothing cloned — but what makes it different is not the voices, it is what they share: one power rail that sags in pitch as well as level when a kick lands, one shell every channel feeds, and a bleed web so that hitting the snare rings the toms. It is the glue that bus compression is an apology for, built in at the circuit. Then a thirty-two step sequencer with a last step per lane for polyrhythms, two hundred generated kits, and a fader that morphs between any two of them.
note: Windows VST3 · build 260827.22 · free download · 13-page manual included.
